I have enough to deliver the verdict without churning the task tracker. Here is the synthesis.

---

VERDICT: The DoD claim is NOT sound as written. Two DoD-BLOCKING gaps invalidate it. Both are framing/instrument defects, not perf regressions — fully consistent with the task's faithfulness/totality gradient and fixable WITHOUT GPU. The underlying refactor (11 byte-identical commits, helion/ tree identical at 479df334 and HEAD 623556ea) is sound; the failure is that the REPORT over-claims two conjuncts beyond what the artifacts establish.

=== (1) DoD-BLOCKING GAPS (must fix before re-banking) ===

BLOCKER A — COVERAGE conjunct 5 is FALSE for the gaps it names (the decisive gap).
The COVERAGE conjunct requires the §3b.5-named gaps (rollable-secondary, pinned-full-extent-grid secondary, combinations = probes P1/P2/P4/P5) to be "RED on fc1dbaa0 and GREEN after." I confirmed a direct, in-worktree CONTRADICTION:
- NOTEBOOK.md:153 (the driver's own KEY BOOTSTRAP FINDING): "All 5 output-hole probes (P1-P5) are GREEN at fc1dbaa0 (no crash / no floor-1 / no no-fire)" — and explicitly reasons that Rounds 4-5 already closed the Issue-7/8 holes, so P1-P5 became totality-regression guards, not RED->GREEN demonstrations.
- red_probes.py:1-2 docstring asserts the opposite verbatim: "confirmed RED at fc1dbaa0, turned GREEN by the unification."
- REPORT.md:99-100 then claims "known gaps (P1-P5) + 6 ... holes ... all RED→GREEN."
There is no RED-at-base artifact for P1-P5 anywhere (no saved run JSON; red_probes.py's main just prints "n/5 RED at this SHA"). The two prose claims cannot both be true; the NOTEBOOK bootstrap finding is the load-bearing one (it shaped the whole refactor's gradient toward structure). So the conjunct-5-NAMED gaps were green-at-base / green-after — a no-op fixture, not a RED->GREEN demonstration. This is exactly the self-laundering pattern the completeness-critic exists to catch (the gradient is self-judged). The honest framing: "P1-P5 were already closed in fc1dbaa0; they are permanent totality-regression guards. The refactor preserved them byte-identically." FIX (no GPU): rewrite REPORT conjunct 5 to that framing, and reconcile the red_probes.py docstring's "confirmed RED" line with NOTEBOOK:153.

BLOCKER B — open_RED was certified =0 on a strictly weaker check than its own definition; the §5b PERF tripwire does not exist.
Task §3a.4 defines open_RED to include "the compiler DEFAULT config beats the seed" (the model-well floor), and §5b mandates the mechanical checker carry a default-vs-seed PERF tripwire. I confirmed:
- No perf_tripwire.py exists anywhere in the worktree (find -iname '*tripwire*' returns nothing; the only reference is checker.py:21 deferring to a file that was never written).
- checker.py is compile-only by its own docstring (flags CRASH / NO_FIRE / FLOOR1_TILED; "UNJUSTIFIED ... left for the divergence/Gate-D analysis").
- The default-vs-seed model-well A/B was run exactly twice in the whole run (ledger gate_verdicts: cf065557 len==1 BROADEN, bfa012cc grid-tile), never on any of the 30 Gate-T sweep kernels nor any saturation-axis kernel. gateT_round3_DRY.json is compile-only.
So "Gate T DRY, open_RED=0" (conjunct 1) is certified only against the CRASH/NO_FIRE/FLOOR1 branches of open_RED, never against the default-beats-seed branch that is part of its §3a.4 definition. A minted kernel that compiles, fires, and isn't floored could still emit a default-beats-seed config (RED by definition) and the sweep had no instrument to see it. "Dry" rests on a weaker check than the definition. FIX: either (a) build the §5b tripwire and re-run it on the round-3 corpus to genuinely retire the branch (needs GPU — defer to the GPU-bearing follow-up), or (b) re-scope the TOTALITY conjunct's prose to "open_RED=0 over the compile-time branches (crash/no-fire/floor-1); the model-well/default-beats-seed branch is certified only on the 2 BROADEN kernels and is an open GPU follow-up." Option (b) is the honest analysis-only fix and is sufficient to un-block the conjunct as stated.

Note both blockers are DOCUMENTATION/SCOPE corrections, not code regressions. The helion/ code at HEAD is unchanged from the DoD SHA (git diff 479df334 HEAD -- helion/ is empty, verified). Re-banking requires editing REPORT.md (and one red_probes.py docstring line), not re-doing the refactor.

=== (2) PRIORITY-2 FOLLOW-UP GAPS (BROADEN/refactor queue) ===

The single most material non-blocking framing gap — conjunct-3 disjunct over-reach (process hunt + audit hunt agree). REPORT conjunct 3 lists 7 keys as "Gate-D PASS or covered by the Gate-T DRY adversarial sweep." Only 3 have an actual Gate-D verdict (ledger gate_verdicts): r_block_resident-narrowed=PASS (cf065557), GRO=PASS (2bf66355), M_COLLAPSE_TILE_BYTES=PASS (cf065557 round 2). The other 4 (grid_collapse_block_ids, _resident_itemsize, reduction_loops-by-slot, dominant-fact pick) are Gate-T-covered only — and Gate-T (checker.py:13) explicitly defers faithfulness. "Gate-T covered" is a TOTALITY certificate, not a faithfulness one; the "or covered by Gate-T" disjunct makes the conjunct READ as if all 7 are faithfulness-certified. This does NOT flip the conjunct's truth IF you accept the diff-anchored debt rule (counter 2=0 is defensible because those keys' divergence debt was either pre-existing or conservative-direction), but the prose conflates the two gates. Recommend tightening the wording even though it's below the blocker bar.

Concrete Priority-2 divergence/coverage debts (all conservative-direction, none a measured regression):
- fp8/int8 dtype path the refactor altered (1->4 divisor in _resident_itemsize) is exercised by ZERO committed probes (grep: no torch.float8/int8 tensor) and ZERO anchor cells (verified: anchor dist is fp32=341/bf16=100/fp16=6; the 12 "fp8" anchor kernels are bf16-dtyped output-quant, not fp8 reductions). Direction is conservative (more pessimistic budget -> bias toward looping), so probably safe — but unproven by construction. Add an fp8/int8 reduction probe (compile-time floor check now; default-vs-seed when GPU returns).
- carried-resident term (_carried_tile_budget, lever 5) has a "does it bite" fixture (r3_bf16_carried_2d) but no proxy-vs-property divergence kernel per §5d, despite §3b.3 naming it. (row_reread is correctly debt-FREE: diff-anchored — git diff fc1dbaa0 HEAD has no row_reread hit; do NOT chase it.)
- Four post-round-2 levers (bfa012cc PARTIAL_GRID, 2e5926ab _resident_itemsize, e9440ae4 geometric split + reduction_loops-by-slot, 479df334 grid_collapse_block_ids) landed AFTER counter 2 was zeroed at cf065557 and never got fresh Gate-D rounds. The geometric n-th-root occupancy split and NARROW_W1_OCC_BYTE_LIMIT=262144 each owe an equal-footprint divergence test.
- Budget-constant cluster: only M_COLLAPSE_TILE_BYTES of the 7 constants (triton.py:496-524) cleared Gate-D; ROW_PERSIST_MAX_BYTES (the most load-bearing), LIVE_PERSIST_BUDGET, LOOPED_CHUNK, CARRIED_TILE_MAX_BYTES, M_COLLAPSE_MAX_CTA, MIN_WAVES are validated only by byte-identity + totality.
- Un-minted cross-product cell: CARRIED-RESIDENT(num_carried_2d_tiles>=2) x CO-RESIDENCY=same-loop (every carried probe lands ==1; the _carried_tile_budget ÷max(1,n) path for n=2 is unexercised). Conservative-direction.
- strided-dim0 out-of-scope DECLINE path (checker.py:129-144) never triggered by a real minted kernel (§3a.4 "THE ONE EXCEPTION" explicitly permits this — lowest priority).
- BROADEN-edit perf ratios (cf065557 0.876/1.016; bfa012cc 0.612/1.012) exist only as NOTEBOOK prose with no persisted JSON, and were each checked at only 2 hand-picked shapes — violating the run's own [[feedback_ab_sweep_flip_axis]] discipline (bfa012cc flips grid occupancy as a function of M; a 2-point check is the exact anti-pattern that missed a 4-7x valley before). Re-A/B across the swept flip axis when GPU returns.
- Process hygiene: lever 6 (delete 2 dead constants) is byte-identical-by-construction and leaves the smell cluster still counted as 1 — it is cosmetic/hygiene mislabeled non-cosmetic (does not change any counter truth). REPORT conjunct 4's "device_ir hunks confined to 1097-1792" is inaccurate (there is also a ~96-122 enum-rename hunk) — substance fine, line-range wrong.

=== (3) CLAIMED-COVERED CONJUNCTS THAT ARE GENUINELY SOLID ===

- PERF selection-only proof — SOUND, and independently hardened post-DoD (623556ea). git diff fc1dbaa0 HEAD outside _lab/ touches only triton.py, device_ir.py, config_spec.py; the new device_ir fns are read-only graph walkers (no roller/lowering touched); ReductionFact feeds only get_seed_config. Config-identity => Triton-identity => perf-identity is a real argument, not a config-only false-all-clear. The bf16 byte-identity is precisely correct (92/100 bf16 cells have itemsize=4 making max(itemsize,4) a no-op; the rest are far below caps).
- The 6 generator/Gate-T-found holes ARE genuine RED->GREEN regression probes (NOT manufactured): ledger gate_verdicts confirms 3 NOT-DRY rounds (4735ac7d open_RED=2, d9eeca73 open_RED=1) with real binding falsifications before the round-3 DRY. multi_rolled_slot_misplace, dual_grid_occupancy, gro_cross_loop_bleed, len==1 (cf065557), grid-tile (bfa012cc), bf16 dtype each fired pre-fix. The gate has demonstrated teeth.
- The §1 axis cross-product (ACCESS / ORIGIN / EXTENT / DIMS 1-5D / PINNED-GRID / NON-REDUCTION-LOOP / CO-RESIDENCY) is broadly and genuinely exercised across gen/ and gateT/, not a paper claim.
- M_COLLAPSE_TILE_BYTES (gateD_r2_claim2) and GRO (gro_divergence, 2bf66355) are genuine §5d divergence tests (equal-footprint / >=2 distinct families / property-not-recognizer). The Defect-1 NARROWED claim is a legitimate faithfulness narrowing (Gate-D PASS round 2), correctly logged with the looped-residency over-count parked to human-review — handled honestly.
- STRUCTURE L1/L2/L4 greppable-confirmed (per_feature_accumulator gone, no reduction_loops-membership tile-width key, ReductionRole->ReductionAxisKind decision-at-consumer). Defect-3 is a verified pure rename.
- Op-identity (sum/prod/amax/argmax/var/cumsum) is correctly exempt from being a missing axis at compile time (heuristic keys on itemsize+extent+access, never op name).
- DoD verdict transfers cleanly from 479df334 to HEAD (helion/ diff empty).

BOTTOM LINE: The refactor is real, byte-identical, and structurally sound; counters 1/3/4 (special_case, perf, totality-as-fall-through) are well-founded. But the REPORT asserts two conjuncts beyond their evidence: COVERAGE claims RED->GREEN for P1-P5 that the driver's own bootstrap proves were green-at-base (BLOCKER A), and TOTALITY banks open_RED=0 while the default-beats-seed branch of open_RED's definition was never instrumented on the certifying corpus (BLOCKER B). Re-bank only after rewriting conjunct 5 to the totality-guard framing, scoping conjunct 1's open_RED to its measured (compile-time) branches with the model-well floor flagged as the open GPU follow-up, and reconciling the red_probes.py "confirmed RED" docstring with NOTEBOOK:153. All three fixes are analysis-only.
